title: Australian officer says Buchanan also knocked out Australian computers
place_text: Bureau of Indian Affairs cafeteria; Australia

tellings.quote: You know, you're the one that knocked out our computers over in Australia."

plain: An Australian officer is said to have walked up to an Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan in a Bureau of Indian Affairs cafeteria and told him, 'you're the one that knocked out our computers over in Australia.' Buchanan tells this himself on the show, as something said to him. If true, it would mean Buchanan had somehow put computers out of action on the other side of the world.
